item.title: Managing synchronized Exchange objects without an Exchange Server
item.author: Andreas Dieckmann
item.description:
It has been possible for some time to use the Exchange Server management tools without a full Exchange Server. Most guides assume that at least one Exchange Server already existed and was then removed. And the Microsoft documentation only briefly mentions the topic and does not really explain it.

In this post I look at a scenario that affects many smaller companies: In the Microsoft 365 Admin Center it says:
